final_rationale: The verdict does not change because the Actor introduced no new admissible evidence and largely narrowed its position to match the original concern. That clarification is useful, but it is a reinterpretation of the same record, not proof that the missing compliance predicate has been satisfied. The policy allows certification only if current release documentation reflects current evaluation results and material segment weaknesses are disclosed or covered by approved mitigation. The available evidence still shows aggregate readiness and no severity-one rehearsal incidents, but it also shows a named launch use-case regression in the tax filing assistant slice and only an informal monitoring note with no reviewed mitigation, owner acceptance, or disclosure language. That means the strongest defensible position is that certification could become supportable if current disclosure or approved mitigation is added, not that the present record is already compliant. Because the required condition remains unresolved on the existing evidence, suspicious remains the proportional final verdict rather than compliant_with_caveats.
